# Troubleshooting tools

Adds common network troubleshooting tools (dig, nslookup, netstat, ping, traceroute) to any container, installed during container start.

Add it to any LinuxServer.io container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-package-install`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

The packages are added to the shared mod package install list and installed once by the base image's
`init-mods-package-install` step: `dnsutils`, `net-tools`, `iputils-ping` and `traceroute` on Ubuntu based
images, `bind-tools` and `net-tools` on Alpine based images. Nothing is configured; the tools are simply
available in the container after start.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/universal-tshoot/
